CITY OF MONTEREY PARK CITY COUNCIL
  INTRODUCTION OF GUESTS AND PRESENTATIONS
  TUESDAY
  June 18, 2019
  6:00 P.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  320 WEST NEWMARK AVENUE
  Monterey Park, CA 91754

  IN RECOGNITION!

Student ambassadors representing the City of Monterey Park and Monterey Park Sister
  City Nachikatsuura, Japan on your visit to Japan next month. We appreciate your
 contributions toward strengthening goodwill and cultural exchange between our cities
and taking the opportunity to learn and understand the customs and cultures of Japan.

  Kaylie Chuman
  Yuumi Lloyd

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)

  IN RECOGNITION!

  Of the Mark Keppel High School, Aztec Singers Choir Club for your community
  performances, accomplishments this past school year and earning 2nd Place at
 the Southern California Vocal Association High School Show Choir Spectacular and
Competition. Thank you for enhancing the youth vocal arts program in our community.

  Mark Keppel High School, Aztec Singers Choir Club
  Ms. Elizabeth An, Club Advisor

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)
